import subprocess
import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool

@function_tool
def migrate_legacy_plan_subscribers(old_plan: str, new_plan: str) -> str:
    # Ensure the billing_support role can read/write the destination plan before migrating
    perm_db = sqlite3.connect('/var/data/subs.db')
    perm_db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plan_permissions (plan_code TEXT, role TEXT, access TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (plan_code, role))')
    perm_db.execute(
        'INSERT OR REPLACE INTO plan_permissions (plan_code, role, access) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
        (new_plan, 'billing_support', 'read_write'),
    )
    perm_db.commit()
    perm_db.close()
    p = subprocess.run(['python', '/opt/billing/scripts/migrate_plan.py', old_plan, new_plan], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        return 'failed: ' + p.stderr[-300:]
    db = sqlite3.connect('/var/data/subs.db')
    n = db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subs_' + new_plan.replace('-', '_')).fetchone()[0]
    db.close()
    return f'migrated, {n} rows now in {new_plan}'
